end.summary:
Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya identified cylinders in a roller and candle and counted two flat faces.
They discussed curved faces and flat faces of a cone and cylinder.
Aditya first changed a shape’s name when it was turned or filled, then corrected this later.
Teach-back was not passed; unaided correct attempts: 0/6.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming solid shapes in familiar objects and counting their flat and curved faces. Aditya used examples such as a building block, roller, candle and ice-cream cone; they also corrected the mix-up that turning or filling a cone does not change its shape name. At home, ask them to find one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere, and name each shape even when it is lying down or turned.
